topic: Texas energy assistance (CEAP/LIHEAP), TANF cash assistance, Lifeline, unemployment insurance, and Child Care Services (CCS) eligibility and benefit amounts
effective_period: CEAP/LIHEAP: FFY2026 (10/01/2025-09/30/2026) plan and FFY2027 plan, income limits effective 2026-01-26 (2026 HHS poverty guidelines); TANF: effective 2025-10-01 (Texas Works Handbook Revision 25-4); UI: effective 2025-10-05; Lifeline: 2026 poverty guidelines; CCS: BCY2026 (2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30) and BCY2027 (2026-10-01 to 2027-09-30)

ceap_liheap_income_eligibility.state_plan_threshold_text: All Household Sizes / USHHS Poverty Guidelines / 150% (heating, cooling, crisis, weatherization components; FFY2026 and FFY2027 plans)

FFY2026.minimum_benefit_note: Texas does not have a minimum benefit; $1 entered because OLDC system requires a figure

effective_2025-10-01.handbook_section: C-111, Texas Works Handbook Revision 25-4, effective Oct. 1, 2025

2.note: Caretaker and second parent of child receiving SSI

qualifying_programs_tribal_lands_additio: Bureau of Indian Affairs General Assistance
lifeline.texas_notes: Texas is an NLAD opt-out state (per USAC). Texas PUC state-specific Lifeline pages returned HTTP 402 and could not be verified; no Texas-specific supplemental amount or threshold is recorded here.

texas_unemployment_insurance.wba_formula: highest-wage base period quarter divided by 25, rounded to nearest dollar, bounded by min/max WBA
texas_unemployment_insurance.max_benefit_amount_formula: lesser of 26 x WBA or 27% of total base-period wages

texas_child_care_services_ccs.parent_share_of_cost_cap_text: The parent share of cost will not exceed 7% of the family's household income (childcare.texas.gov)

BCY2026.smi_reference: LIHEAP IM2025-02 Federal Poverty Guidelines and State Median Income Estimates

BCY2027.smi_reference: LIHEAP IM2026-01 Federal Poverty Guidelines and State Median Income Estimates

notes: All values transcribed from official pages/PDFs fetched 2026-09-26; nothing estimated. CEAP: TDHCA income guidelines page shows CEAP and LIHEAP-WAP at 150% of 2026 FPIG effective 2026-01-26. CEAP benefit tiers are per 10 TAC 6.309(e): 0-50% FPIG up to $1,800 per component (Utility Assistance and Crisis Assistance), >50-75% up to $1,500, >75-150% up to $1,200; household annual cap $12,600 ($1,800 crisis + $1,800 utility + $9,000 HVAC); the initial payment including arrears does not count toward the annual cap. The FFY2027 plan PDF (27-LIHEAP.pdf) still carries a 'FEDERAL FISCAL YEAR 2026' cover heading and a stale 'FY 2024' label in item 2.6, but includes an FY2027 monitoring schedule; its benefit figures match FFY2026. Public comments asked to raise the tiers to $1,600/$1,900/$2,200; the plan did not adopt that. TANF: the handbook currently shows allowances effective 2025-10-01 (Revision 25-4). No 2026-10-01 revision was found when fetched, so check again after October 1. Family size 1 and second-parent size 2 rows apply only to caretakers of SSI children. UI: TWC shows $75/$605 effective 2025-10-05. The page was last updated 2026-07-07 and lists no October 2026 amounts yet. Lifeline: federal threshold 135% FPG; discounts $9.25 standard and $34.25 Tribal. Texas PUC pages could not be fetched (HTTP 402), so no Texas-specific Lifeline supplement or threshold is included. CCS: the fetched TWC PDFs give dollar income limits and maximum parent share of cost by family size (1-15), but they do not state the SMI percentage in the extracted text, so smi_percent is null. Per the PDFs, the limits derive from the LIHEAP IM State Median Income estimates. Weekly, bi-weekly and bi-monthly columns also exist in the source PDFs and are left out here. Max PSOC is about 7% of the income limit. pdftotext layout shifted the row labels by one line; values were reassigned in order starting at family size 1 and checked against the monthly = annual/12 and PSOC = 7% relationships.
